title: Birth keeper told mother of baby who later died to ‘go home and rest’, NSW inquest hears
summary_full: Sita Kali was involved in care for two of four babies who died between 2022 and 2024 in Lismore after free births or home birthsGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastA self-described birth keeper advised a pregnant woman whose baby later died to “go home and rest” after she was given urgent medical advice to present to an emergency department, the New South Wales coroner’s court has heard.Sita Tara Kali was involved in the care of two of four babies born in free births or home births who died in the northern rivers region between 2022 and 2024. An inquest into the deaths began in the Lismore local court on Monday. The families of the four babies were not present. Continue reading...
